desc: Suppressor ready, black and gray G-10 grips with angled serrations, accessory rail, extended ambidextrous thumb safety; beavertail grip safety; commander hammer; extended slide release; detachable 10-round magazine; dovetailed Combat 3-dot sights; ABS carry case included. Built to 85% of the scale of the original model 1911, Browning has engineered the 1911-22 to be purpose designed for a unique purpose as a rimfire handgun instead of yet another barrel conversion kit gun. Pick one up, admire it, and then buy one - you won't regret it.
